title: Origin story: Morrigan
description: The Morrigan is the phantom queen of Irish myth, goddess of war and fate, who appears as a crow over battlefields and as a washerwoman foretelling doom. She offered Cu Chulainn her love and, refused, opposed him — yet keened over his death, for even gods mourn the heroes they doom.

title: Ability profile: Morrigan
description: Ranked abilities: Prophecy — rank 99/100; Shapeshifting (crow) — rank 98/100; War-incitement — rank 97/100; Terror — rank 96/100; Sovereignty — rank 95/100.

title: Power ranking: Morrigan
description: Powers: The crow's battlefield sight; Doom-foretelling no warrior escapes; The land's sovereignty in her gift.

title: Stamina feats: Morrigan
description: Recorded feats of endurance: Hovers over every war without rest; Her keening outlasts the slain.

title: Crossover notes: Morrigan
description: Morrigan crosses naturally with: war, fate, sovereignty, the battlefield crow.

title: Cultural impact: Morrigan
description: The war-goddess as fate; the crow over every battlefield.
